@graph.howPerformed: In non-cultured melanocyte suspension surgery, an ultra-thin skin graft is taken from a normally pigmented area such as the thigh. A melanocyte suspension is prepared through a specialised lab process and transferred to the prepared white patch. The dressing is usually removed after 7 days, and the best results show 3–6 months after surgery.

acceptedAnswer.text: Many patients see meaningful repigmentation with the right treatment, but the response varies with the type, location and stability of the patches.

mainEntity.name: Who is suitable for vitiligo surgery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Surgical options like melanocyte transplant are generally for stable vitiligo that hasn't responded well to medical or light-based treatment.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: It varies. Light-based treatments need a series of sessions, and surgical results usually show 3–6 months after the procedure.

mainEntity.name: What care is needed during treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avoid excessive sun exposure, apply sunscreen regularly and follow your dermatologist's instructions between sessions.
